title: vtc-chat-delegation guide uses nonexistent Reaction/set
description: jmap-vtc-chat-delegation-guide.md section 5 (Persistent reactions) tells clients to use Reaction/set create with a client-supplied ULID. The base draft has no Reaction/set method; reactions live in the Message reactions map (Message/set reactions patch). Pre-existing; found by spec pass wf_8b8754ae-4d8.
